entries.name: Bars
entries.description: Labeled horizontal bars, in the order given. A full bar is the largest value unless `max` sets it. Each bar can carry a status (ok, warn, error) or a tone for its color.

entries.name: Checks over a log
entries.description: What is down, then why: a column with uptime checks on top and the log of the failing service under them.

entries.name: Column
entries.description: Widgets stacked top to bottom. A column has only `children`. Most tiles are a column at the top: a headline number, then a chart or a list under it.

children.text: Discharging. Full charge 4,512 mAh of 5,000 (90% health).

entries.name: Pie: donut
entries.description: The same widget as a ring, which is the default. `format: bytes` writes the legend in GiB. A slice's status (here warn on the free space) overrides its color.

entries.name: Gauge
entries.description: A meter from 0 to 100%. Thresholds turn the fill the warn and error colors as it rises; a marker puts a tick on the track, for example where usage should be by now; a caption adds a line of detail under it.

root.label: 5-hour limit
root.caption: ahead of pace · resets in 1 h 12 m

entries.name: Column of gauges
entries.description: Several limits at once: a column of gauges, each with its own thresholds. The marker on the first two shows where usage should be by now, so "ahead of pace" is easy to see.

entries.name: Stats over a chart
entries.description: The usual KPI tile: a row of stats across the top and a chart of the main number under it. A column holding a row and a series.

entries.name: List
entries.description: Items with a title, a quieter subtitle, a marker colored by status or tone, and tags shown as chips. An `open_url` action makes an item a link. `empty_text` is what shows when there are no items.

entries.name: Log
entries.description: Log lines, oldest first; renderers show the newest that fit. Each line can have a time, shown before it, and a level (error, warn, info, debug) that colors it.

lines.text: slow query took 540ms: SELECT * FROM runs

entries.name: Meter grid
entries.description: Many small meters in a compact grid, one per CPU core, disk or queue. The grid's `color` scale colors each meter by its value; a meter's own `tone` overrides it.

entries.name: Row in a column in a row
entries.description: Layouts nest as deep as you like. Here the outer row has a column on the left, holding a row of two stats over a gauge, and a list on the right.

entries.name: Pie next to stats
entries.description: A donut beside the numbers it stands for: a row holding a pie and a column of stats. The pie gives the shape at a glance, the stats the exact values.

entries.name: Pie
entries.description: Shares of a whole, as a full disc with `donut: false`. Slices go clockwise from twelve o'clock in the order given and take the theme's series colors in turn; the legend shows each value and its percent.

entries.name: Row
entries.description: Widgets side by side, sharing the width. A row has only `children`; it is how a tile puts things next to each other. In a narrow space the children get narrow too, so keep rows short.

entries.name: Series: area
entries.description: The same series filled under the line, with `style: area`. `y_max` fixes the top of the chart, here 100%, so a quiet hour doesn't look busy. A single series takes its color from `color`: the accent, or a scale (heat, cool, sunset).

entries.name: Series: bars
entries.description: One column per sample, with `style: bars`. With the heat scale each bar is colored by its value, green to red. `format: count` writes big numbers short (12.3k).

entries.name: Series: line
entries.description: Values over time as lines. Points are `[unix milliseconds, value]`. Several series get the theme's series colors in order, or a `tone` each. Set `id` and the dashboard keeps the history, so a module can send one new point per update.

entries.name: Series: mirrored
entries.description: Two series on one axis, the first above it and the second below, with `mirrored: true`. Made for pairs like download and upload. `format: bytes` writes values as KiB, MiB and GiB, and `unit` is added after.

entries.name: Stat
entries.description: One number with a label. The value is a string, already formatted, so the module decides how it reads ("3451", "1.2k", "4:12"). A unit, a change since last time (delta) and a status (ok, warn, error) are optional; the status colors the value.

entries.name: Table with widgets in cells
entries.description: A table whose cells hold widgets: a gauge per limit, a pie of what the usage went to and a stat with its status. Stat, gauge and pie draw inline in a cell; other widgets fall back to text. In the terminal a pie cell shows its largest slice.

entries.name: Table
entries.description: Rows and columns. Columns have a key and a heading; each row's `cells` are keyed by column. A cell is text or a number, and a row can have a status and an action. Cells can also hold a stat, a gauge or a pie (see the table with widgets).

entries.name: Text
entries.description: A paragraph of text. With `markdown: true`, two stars on each side make bold and backticks make code; nothing else is markup, so text from an API shows as written. Good for a note, a status line, or the one thing a tile has to say.

root.text: **Release freeze** starts Thursday at 18:00. Ask in `#deploys` before merging, and tag the release with `v2.4.0`.

entries.name: Tones
entries.description: Widgets never carry raw colors. They name a tone, and each renderer looks it up in the color theme in use: accent, the status colors, muted, and six series colors. Here every tone is one bar; switch the color theme to see them change.

entries.name: Uptime
entries.description: Availability checks, one row each: the latest result, the share of recent checks that passed, the response time, a detail such as "HTTP 200", and a strip of recent results. A `url` makes the row a link.
